headlines.title: On the ground in Texas, Michigan and Maine: Voters speak out at polls on key Senate races
headlines.description: NBC News' Gadi Schwartz reports from Texas, Stephanie Gosk checks in from Michigan and Monica Alba has the latest from Maine on Election Day.

headlines.title: Exit poll: Voters cast ballots against Trump
headlines.description: The president’s approval rating dropped among voters, who have big concerns about the economy, according to early polling results.
headlines.source: Stephanie Perry, NBC News Exit Poll Desk

headlines.title: Steve Kornacki analyzes midterm election results live all night long
headlines.description: Follow NBC News Chief Data Analyst Steve Kornacki on camera and behind-the-scenes as he breaks down real-time vote tallies for the 2026 midterm elections.

headlines.title: Democrats have polling and history on their side in House races
headlines.description: The House of Representatives is up for grabs Tuesday as Democrats try to wrest control from Republicans, who have enjoyed power in the chamber for the past four years but are facing formidable political headwinds.

headlines.title: GOP fights to hang on to Senate majority
headlines.description: Control of the Senate is on the line Tuesday following a midterm election cycle with races marked by betrayal and alleged ballot shenanigans.

headlines.title: Routine voting issues fuel conspiracy theories and confusion
headlines.description: Westchester County ballot tabulators malfunctioned across the county Tuesday, alarming voters and fueling a flurry of conspiracy theories online.

headlines.title: Floods and severe weather beset parts of the U.S. on Election Day
headlines.description: Flash flooding, heavy rain and tornadoes have forced election officials in three different regions across the U.S. to move polling locations, scrambling Election Day plans in hot-button races.

headlines.title: In top Senate race states, gas and grocery costs are rising faster than the national average
headlines.description: From gas and groceries to housing and wage growth, midterm voters who are being squeezed by inflation say the economy is their top issue this Election Day.

headlines.title: Inside the Decision Desk: When will we know Senate and House control?
headlines.description: Americans might be waiting awhile. It all depends on how states count their votes and how close the races will be.

headlines.title: NBC News Exit Poll: How it works and how we use the results on election night
headlines.description: Before votes are tallied on election night, exit polls offer an early look at who is voting and what is motivating their choices.
headlines.source: Stephanie Perry, NBC News Exit Poll Desk

headlines.title: NBC News exit polls compare voters' thoughts on Trump's economy in 2018 and 2026
headlines.description: As voters head to the polls, NBC News exit polls captured voters thoughts on the economy. NBC News' Christine Romans compares those exit polls to those during President Trump's first midterms in 2018.

headlines.title: DOJ sending election monitors to all 50 states for the first time in U.S. history
headlines.description: The Department of Justice is sending election monitors to polling sites in all 50 states for the first time in U.S. history. NBC News' Justin Levitt discusses how the election monitors have worked in previous elections and how they will operate during the midterms.
